Notes.Text:
This update for bcel fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-94114: Nested Code/Record attributes drive unbounded parse-time recursion in ClassParser (bsc#1284400).
- CVE-2026-105111: Class2HTML emits unescaped class strings, enabling stored XSS (bsc#1284399).

 + Nested Code/Record attributes drive unbounded parse-time

 emitted bytecode
 + Class2HTML emitters write attacker class-file strings into
 HTML unescaped (stored XSS in reports) (bsc#1284399,
 CVE-2026-105111)
 + Class2HTML builds output file paths from the unvalidated class
 name
 + ClassPath.getBytes() sizes its buffer from the forged ZIP
 uncompressed-size field
 + PMG attribute ignores declared length, enabling BCEL-vs-JVM
 parse divergence
 + Signature.matchGJIdent recurses unboundedly on nested generic
 signatures (Signature.translate)
 + Utility.decode fixed 3x buffer breaks the encode/decode round
 trip and throws unchecked AIOOBE
 + BCELifier interpolates attacker class/package names into
 generated Java source unescaped
 + Verifier pass 3a delayed checks are quadratic in attribute and
 code size
 + Verifier cache grows unboundedly with attacker-chosen class
 names
 + Static WIDE ThreadLocal survives exceptions, corrupting the
 next class's disassembly on the same thread
 + Utility.JavaReader escape decoding: OOB table index, bad-hex
 crash, silent non-canonical aliasing

Vulnerabilities.Description:
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in Apache Commons BCEL.



This only happens when you're using Class2HTML to generate webpages for possibly-attacker-controlled class files, where Class2HTML emitters write attacker class-file strings into HTML unescaped (stored XSS in reports).



This issue affects Apache Commons BCEL: before 6.13.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.13.0, which fixes the issue.

ProductID: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server for SAP applications 16.0:bcel-6.13.0-160000.1.1
SUSE Linux Enterprise Server for SAP applications 16.0:bcel-javadoc-6.13.0-160000.1.1

Vulnerabilities.Description:
Symbolic name not mapping to correct class.



BCEL caches attacker-controlled classes under their self-declared names without validating the requested name, allowing subsequent lookups and name-keyed verification results to refer to a different class.



This issue affects Apache Commons BCEL: before 6.13.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.13.0, which fixes the issue.
